name: Tiger Creek Farms
tagline: Tiger Valley Farm — Arugula in Pickens, SC
description: Tiger Creek Farms grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 285 Holmes Pond Road, SC. The farm is family-run, and its seasons run through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
